leaves.doc: C8: Conrad Appendix B at local base Q_p, as printed: the p. 32 equivalence (locally algebraic in the sense of Definition B.1, a Q_p-homomorphism of tori G_m -> R_{K/Q_p} G_m agreeing with psi o r near 1, iff Hodge-Tate in Conrad's line form) and Proposition B.3 for Hodge-Tate psi with the (B.1) display.
leaves.flag: pending review: printed form with Definition B.1 over tori and B.3 under Hodge-Tate; verbatim quotes of pp. 32-33 in docs/research/conrad-appb-b1-b3-quotes.md (AI read from the page images); awaiting the two-lens rating; the citation is an unrefereed author preprint (eligibility open); Definition B.1's torus homomorphism is a natural transformation of unit functors on Q_p-algebras (Yoneda stated, not proved)
leaves.source: Brian Conrad, Lifting global representations with local properties, author preprint December 11, 2011, Appendix B pp. 32-33, Definition B.1 and Proposition B.3 (proof pp. 33-34); diophantine_zq.tex sec:height L760-764, conrad-local-characters L11046-11049
